`cursor=slack_c2`
`limit=30` | | **Headers** | `x-apikey: sl_key456` | **Full request example (curl)** ```bash curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource=slack.com&cursor=slack_c2&limit=30" \ -H "x-apikey: sl_key456" ``` **What you’ll receive** The JSON response will include: - An array of comment objects (each containing the comment text, author, timestamp, etc.). - A `next_cursor` field (if more results are available) that you can use for subsequent pagination.
